verdictMeaning: A new class starts at dawn on September 28, 1835 (FIC-GONZ-024). Every moment of the Gonzales timeline is 1080 minutes later on its clock, so the first news of the cannon still comes at ten o'clock on September 29 (HIST-GONZ-002): 28 in-game hours and 13.3 real minutes at the Study pace. Nothing historical happens before it, while chores and trades run. A class saved before this has no arrival marker and keeps exactly the timeline it was playing; no save version moved.
implementation: TIMELINE is now FROM_MIDNIGHT_SEPT_29 + ARRIVAL_MINUTES. Every director comparison goes through momentOf(world, key), which subtracts ARRIVAL_MINUTES for a class without director.arrival. historicalDate starts from dawn on the 28th for a new class and midnight on the 29th for an old one.
specCorrection: docs/SETTLING_IN.md first said an offset of 1800 minutes; dawn on the 28th to midnight on the 29th is 18 hours, 1080 minutes. Corrected.
